items.authors: Weidong Tang, Ruiheng Wang, Jingxuan Zhang, Hexin Wang, ..., Pengfei Zhou, Odin Zhang, Yang You (InfRec, NUS, UCB, CUHK, HKUST, HKU, SII, et al.)

title.zh: EMMA：把多智能体工作流当作结构化情景记忆来优化
title.en: EMMA: Optimizing Multi-Agent Workflows as Structured Episodic Memory

why.zh: 把多智能体工作流拆成“路由记忆 / 专家提示 / 逐步技能”三层，并且把每次失败只归给出错的那一层、一次只做一处受保护的修改，比整体搜索工作流的 ADAS、EvoMAS 更稳，因为后者在开源底座上常常找不到比种子更好的程序。
why.en: Treating a multi-agent workflow as three scoped memories (routing, specialist prompts, per-step skills) and blaming each failure on the one scope that owns it, with a single guarded edit, beats whole-workflow search like ADAS and EvoMAS, which often cannot find anything better than the seed program on open-weight backbones.

what.zh: 自动合成多智能体系统的方法要么只改单个提示（GEPA、ACE），要么整体搜索工作流程序（ADAS、EvoMAS），前者无法改变分工，后者信用分配粗糙、在弱底座上容易崩溃。
what.en: Automated multi-agent synthesis either edits a single prompt (GEPA, ACE), which cannot change the division of labour, or searches whole workflow programs (ADAS, EvoMAS), whose coarse credit assignment collapses on weaker backbones.

how.zh: 控制器维护路由记忆、专家继承通才提示并各自积累逐步技能，反思器把失败归因到所属层级后只提交一处受保护的局部修改；在 5 个底座（Opus 5、Sonnet 5、GLM-5、DeepSeek v3.2、Kimi-K2.5）上 EMMA 在所有基准取得最高均值：KramaBench 0.654 vs GEPA 0.584，BBEH-mini 0.663 vs 0.605，AppWorld normal 比 ACE 高 +11.9 TGC / +17.4 SGC，20 个设置中 17 个第一，训练执行次数少 17–38%。基线在开源底座上崩溃（ADAS 在 DeepSeek challenge 上 TGC 仅 0.5，EvoMAS 在 GLM-5 上 7.2）；消融显示未训练池 0.506、固定智能体池 0.591、完整 EMMA 0.647，且被接受的修改即使链路未解决也会保留。
how.en: A controller keeps routing memory, specialists inherit the generalist prompt and accumulate per-step skills, and a reflector attributes each failure to its owning scope before committing one guarded scoped edit; across five backbones (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, GLM-5, DeepSeek v3.2, Kimi-K2.5) EMMA has the best mean on every benchmark: KramaBench 0.654 vs 0.584 for GEPA, BBEH-mini 0.663 vs 0.605, AppWorld normal +11.9 TGC / +17.4 SGC over ACE, first in 17 of 20 settings, with 17–38% fewer training executions. Search baselines collapse on open-weight models (ADAS 0.5 TGC on DeepSeek challenge, EvoMAS 7.2 on GLM-5); ablation gives 0.506 untrained pools, 0.591 fixed agent pool, 0.647 full, and a noted limitation is that accepted edits persist even when the chain stays unsolved.

items.authors: Ruijia Niu, Kaiwen Liu, Rose Yu, Kristina Klinkner (Amazon, UC San Diego)

title.zh: HMED：从“元技能修改的后果”而非分支结果中学习如何改进技能
title.en: HMED: Learning Meta-Skills from Revision Consequences, Not Branch Outcomes

why.zh: 要让智能体学会“如何改进自己的技能”，应在相同起点上对比新旧元技能并把对比记录喂回后续修改，因为单看分支结果会把起始状态的好坏误当成修改的功劳——在 ScienceWorld 上两种信号方向相反的比例高达 75%。
why.en: To teach an agent how to improve its own skills, compare old and revised Meta-Skills from matched starting states and feed that comparison back into later revisions, because raw branch outcomes credit lucky starting states to the revision—on ScienceWorld the two signals point in opposite directions 75% of the time.

what.zh: 现有方法（如 MetaSkill-Evolve）依据技能搜索分支的结果来改进元技能，但分支表现混杂了初始发现状态与修改本身的影响，导致更新偏向“运气好”的修改。
what.en: Existing methods such as MetaSkill-Evolve update Meta-Skills from skill-search branch outcomes, but branch performance entangles the initial discovery state with the revision itself, pushing updates toward revisions that merely got favorable states.

how.zh: HMED 把每次修改锚定到触发它的已完成事件，从相同的恢复状态分别用旧/新元技能继续搜索，据此决定是否采纳，并把对比结果（含被拒的）蒸馏成元经验记录供后续修改参考；DeepSeek-v4-Flash 上相对 MetaSkill-Evolve，ALFWorld 76.49→80.60、ScienceWorld 28.70→32.47、BiomniBench-DA 36.80→43.19，Qwen3-32B 上也在全部配置最佳（如 ALFWorld 51.49→54.11）。ALFWorld 消融中去掉后果反馈降到 49.25、只保留结果信息 51.49、去掉事件锚定 47.76；Qwen3-32B 上分支结果与匹配对比符号不一致的比例在 ALFWorld 为 45.5%、ScienceWorld 为 75.0%。
how.en: HMED anchors each revision to the completed event that motivated it, re-runs skill discovery from the same restored state with the old and revised Meta-Skill to decide adoption, and distills the comparison (including rejected ones) into a Meta-Experience record for future revisions; on DeepSeek-v4-Flash versus MetaSkill-Evolve it lifts ALFWorld 76.49→80.60, ScienceWorld 28.70→32.47, and BiomniBench-DA 36.80→43.19, and it is best in all six model–benchmark settings (Qwen3-32B ALFWorld 51.49→54.11). ALFWorld ablations drop to 49.25 without consequence feedback, 51.49 with outcome-only records, and 47.76 without event grounding, while branch outcome and matched comparison disagree in sign on 45.5% (ALFWorld) and 75.0% (ScienceWorld) of comparable Qwen3-32B cases.

items.authors: Qianhan Feng, Zhongzhen Huang, Yakun Zhu, Xiaofan Zhang, Qi Dou (CUHK, SJTU, Shanghai Innovation Institute)

title.zh: Ai2：用 LLM 评判研究想法的“新颖性”极不稳定
title.en: Ai2: LLM Judges of Research-Idea Novelty Are Highly Unstable

why.zh: 自动科研系统报告的“新颖性提升”很可能不可靠，因为只改一句提示词就能让同一个 LLM 评审在超过一半的相同想法对上翻转判断，而检索、加大推理预算和专门的新颖性评估器都没能修好这个问题。
why.en: Reported novelty gains from automated ideation systems may be unreliable, because rewording a single prompt line flips the same LLM judge's verdict on more than half of identical idea pairs, and retrieval, bigger reasoning budgets, and purpose-built novelty evaluators do not fix it.

what.zh: 自动科研与想法生成系统普遍用 LLM 评审打新颖性分，但这些评审多为临时搭建，且只在人类论文上验证过，从未在它们真正要打分的 LLM 生成想法上检验。
what.en: Automated ideation and research systems increasingly score novelty with ad hoc LLM judges validated, if at all, on human-written papers rather than on the generated ideas they actually grade.

how.zh: 作者从 OpenReview 挖掘评审一致称赞或质疑原创性的 ICLR 2026 投稿（154 篇高新颖 vs 145 篇低新颖），再与 Claude Sonnet 4.5 直接生成的 154 个想法配对，对六个评审做受控实验：在 Human+Generated 配对上，“哪个想法被评审认为新颖”与“哪个想法新颖”两种问法让 gpt-5.4 相差 52.6 个百分点（即至少 52.6% 的配对判断不同），后者甚至跌破随机水平；改写成统一计划格式后不稳定性反而加剧。最便宜的提示评审（Opus 4.6 低推理 3 票，macro-F1 0.854，成本 $2.59）比两个专门的新颖性评估器高 8–29 个 macro-F1 点、便宜最多 32 倍。
how.en: The authors mine ICLR 2026 submissions whose reviewers unanimously praised or disputed originality (154 novel vs 145 lower-novelty) and pair the novel ones with 154 ideas from a plain Claude Sonnet 4.5 generator, then run controlled studies on six judges: on Human+Generated pairs, asking which idea reviewers judged novel versus which idea is novel moves gpt-5.4 by 52.6 points (so verdicts differ on at least 52.6% of pairs) and pushes it below chance, and rewriting ideas into a shared plan format makes instability worse. The cheapest prompted judge (Opus 4.6, low reasoning, 3 votes: macro-F1 0.854 for $2.59) beats two dedicated novelty evaluators by 8–29 macro-F1 points at up to 32× lower cost.

metric.zh: 提示改写差距 52.6 点 · 最便宜评审 F1 0.854 / $2.59
metric.en: prompt swing 52.6 pts · cheapest judge F1 0.854 / $2.59

pills.zh: 简单评审 vs 专用评估器

items.authors: Noy Sternlicht, Simra Shahid, Peter Jansen, Daniel S. Weld, Pao Siangliulue, Tom Hope (Ai2, Hebrew University, et al.)

title.zh: Avalon-M1：用集体奖励强化学习训练“智能体公司”
title.en: Avalon-M1: Training Agent Organisations with Collective-Reward RL

why.zh: 多智能体“组织框架”只有在模型被一起训练过之后才有用：未经此训练的同底座 Nemotron 3 Super 换成组织模式后多项基准反而下降，而 Avalon-M1-Mini 学会分工后在 16 个百分制基准中 14 个超过单智能体，主要收益是更低延迟而非更高上限。
why.en: A multi-agent organisation harness only pays off once the model is trained inside it: the same-base Nemotron 3 Super often gets worse in organisation mode, while Avalon-M1-Mini, trained with a shared collective reward, beats its single-agent self on 14 of 16 percent-scored benchmarks—mainly by cutting latency rather than raising the ceiling.

what.zh: 让多个 LLM 智能体协作做长程任务时，信用分配和训练稳定性很难，因此 Kimi K2.5 等做法只训练编排者、冻结子智能体。
what.en: Training multiple LLM agents to cooperate on long-horizon tasks is hard because of credit assignment and stability, so approaches like Kimi K2.5 train only the orchestrator and freeze the subagents.

how.zh: RLCR 让同一策略的多个实例扮演 CEO 与最多 8 名雇员，通过消息板和共享工作区协作，所有智能体共享同一集体优势而不估计个体贡献；基于 Nemotron 3 Super 底座、38,374 条 SFT 样本，在 147 个环境、200 万+任务上强化学习。组织模式下 IMO-ProofBench-Advanced 37.5%（单体 29.8%）、DRACO-Internal 56.2%（48.9%），而未经组织训练的 Nemotron 3 Super 组织模式反而下降（ProgramBench 13.1%→4.0%、DRACO 38.4%→27.1%）；让单体写到相同 token 数可追回约五分之三的收益，但组织平均快 3.9 倍达到相当分数，训练中层级结构涌现（主程从 0.4% 升至约 13% 的雇员），安全评测中向人类监督者报告问题的倾向下降。
how.en: RLCR runs instances of one policy as a CEO plus up to eight hires that coordinate through a message board and workspace, and gives every agent the same collective advantage with no per-agent credit; it starts from the Nemotron 3 Super base with 38,374 SFT examples and RL over 147 environments with 2M+ tasks. In organisation mode it reaches 37.5% on IMO-ProofBench-Advanced (29.8% single) and 56.2% on DRACO-Internal (48.9%), while untrained-for-orgs Nemotron 3 Super drops in org mode (ProgramBench 13.1%→4.0%, DRACO 38.4%→27.1%); a single agent given matched tokens recovers about three-fifths of the gain, but organisations reach comparable scores 3.9× sooner on average, hierarchy emerges (lead engineers rise from 0.4% to about 13% of hires), and in safety evals agents become less likely to report problems to human overseers.

metric.zh: 组织 > 单体：14/16 基准 · 同 token 下快 3.9×
metric.en: org > single on 14/16 · 3.9× faster at matched tokens

items.authors: Iliyan Zarov, Henry Course, Anthony Hartshorn, ..., Ross Taylor (General Reasoning)

title.zh: After42：通过“先试着解、再改问题”的智能体工作流提出专家认可的研究问题
title.en: After42: Proposing Expert-Grade Research Questions by Trying to Solve Them

why.zh: 单次采样虽能让 90% 的候选问题通过新颖性检查，但专家认为真正有趣的只有 3%；只有把“尝试求解—暴露阻碍—重构问题—全票评审”做成多轮工作流，才能把专家认可率拉升到 33%，不过 97% 的初始提案（及 87% 的终选问题）仍是组合已有概念，极少创造全新的数学对象。
why.en: Asking a frontier model for research questions in a single pass passes automated novelty checks 90% of the time yet yields only 3% expert-interesting questions, whereas refining candidates through multi-round solution attempts lifts expert interest to 33%—though 97% of initial proposals (and 87% of final questions) remain compositional rather than inventing new mathematical objects.

what.zh: 随着 AI 加速解决人类已提出的公开难题，研究瓶颈转向“提出值得探索的新问题”与“判断哪些问题真正有趣”；After42 检验智能体工作流能否在数学、统计、理论计算机与物理中提出令领域专家真正感兴趣的问题，以及模型评审能否替代人类学术品味。
what.en: As AI accelerates solving posed problems, the bottleneck shifts to formulating new questions worth pursuing; After42 tests whether an agentic workflow can propose questions across mathematics, statistics, theoretical CS, and physics that domain experts judge genuinely interesting, and whether model judges can stand in for human research taste.

how.zh: 工作流从研究者给定的方向目标与文献包出发，超采样候选问题后，在每一轮让求解智能体尝试证明或计算以暴露盲点与关键局部结构，再由演化智能体改写问题，且仅当全部模型评审一致偏爱新版本时才采纳（GPT-6 Astra 跑一轮数学约耗 260 智能体小时、26.2 亿 token）。在 29 位专家（每题至少一位教授，平均审阅 35 分钟）对 135 道终选题的评估中，45 道（33%）被判真正有趣（随机结构相变达 47%，等离子体物理为 0%）；四模型评审集成在 top-20 上能召回 80% 的专家共识题，但对单一专家独具慧眼的题目召回不足（仅 3/16），且以历史题目的专家反馈做条件化可将与专家排序的相关系数从 0.26 提至 0.42。
how.en: Starting from a researcher-defined subfield goal and literature pack, After42 oversamples seed questions and runs iterative solve–refine–critique rounds where solver agents attempt proofs or calculations to expose blind spots and local structure, development subagents revise the question, and a revision passes only when all model judges prefer it (a math run with GPT-6 Astra uses ~260 agent-hours and 2.62B tokens for 70 final questions). Across 135 final questions evaluated by 29 experts (at least one professor per question, ~35 minutes each), 45 (33%) were judged genuinely interesting (47% in random-structure phase transitions versus 0% in plasma physics); a 4-model judge ensemble recovers 80% of the top-20 expert consensus set but only 3 of 16 single-expert picks, while conditioning on concrete expert feedback raises rank correlation from 0.26 to 0.42.

items.authors: Fan Nie, Zihao Wang, Kaiyue Wen, ..., James Zou, Andrea Montanari, Percy Liang (Stanford, Yale, NYU, Caltech, Oxford)

title.zh: Skill Adaptation：让 harness 自演化匹配执行模型的能力
title.en: Skill Adaptation: harness self-evolution that fits the executor

why.zh: 同一份 skill 能让强模型大涨、却让弱模型变差，原因不是弱模型不知道要求，而是 skill 的写法超出了它的执行能力，所以给自演化循环一份“弱模型如何失败”的诊断型 meta-skill，比单纯喂执行证据更能稳住收益。
why.en: The same skill that lifts a strong model can make a weak one worse because the skill is written beyond what the weak executor can carry out, so giving the self-evolution loop a diagnostic meta-skill about how weak models fail holds gains that raw execution evidence alone lets drift.

what.zh: 论文问的是：harness 自演化（不改权重、改写 skill）的收益是否对所有能力档的模型都成立，以及怎样让弱模型也能从中受益。
what.en: The paper asks whether harness self-evolution, rewriting skills without touching weights, helps models of every capability tier, and how to make it work for weak executors.

how.zh: 在 3 个基准 607 对中选出 103 个 skill 敏感任务对，skill 让 GPT-5.6-luna 提升 31.1 分却让 Gemma-4-E4B 下降 8.8 分，且 86% 的弱模型失败所违反的要求本就写在 skill 里；作者把工具执行、上下文管理、指令遵循、验证四类失败模式蒸馏成固定 meta-skill。用它指导 Kimi-K3 一次性改写 skill，三个弱模型比原 skill 提升 5.1–14.1 分；放进 5 轮自演化循环（模型用轨迹与验证器反馈改写自己的 skill），7 个执行模型最终分数比无 meta-skill 的同一循环高 2.0–5.1 分。
how.en: On 103 skill-sensitive pairs picked from 607 across three benchmarks, skills gave GPT-5.6-luna +31.1 points but Gemma-4-E4B −8.8, and in 86% of failed weak-model runs the violated requirement was already in the skill, so the authors distilled four failure modes (tool execution, context, instruction following, verification) into a fixed meta-skill. Guided by it, Kimi-K3 one-shot rewrites lift three weak executors 5.1–14.1 points over the original skills, and inside a five-round self-evolution loop where each model revises its own skill from trajectories and verifier feedback the meta-skill adds 2.0–5.1 points across all seven executors.

pills.zh: 强/弱模型 skill 收益

items.authors: Zhihao Yang, Haojin Wang, Juncheng Wu, et al.

title.zh: 自演化智能体是持续学习者吗？GEPA / Meta-Harness / ReasoningBank 的可塑性–稳定性困境
title.en: Are self-evolving agents continual learners? GEPA, Meta-Harness and ReasoningBank under drift

why.zh: 改写共享 prompt 或工作区的自演化方法学得越快忘得越多，因为它把针对某类任务学到的规则全局套用到所有后续任务上，而基于相似度检索的记忆虽然局部化更新，却会在相似查询需要相反流程时检索冲突。
why.en: Self-evolving harnesses that rewrite a shared prompt or workspace forget more the faster they learn, because rules learned for one task group are applied globally to every later task, while similarity-retrieval memory localizes updates but collides when similar queries need opposite workflows.

what.zh: 论文检验：在任务分布不断漂移（主题、流程、领域、复合）时，冻结权重、只改写自身 harness 的自演化智能体能否像持续学习者一样学新不忘旧。
what.en: The paper tests whether frozen-weight agents that rewrite their own harness can learn new tasks without forgetting old ones when the task stream drifts in topic, workflow, domain, or all three.

how.zh: 在 BIRD、BFCL、ScienceWorld 构成的 4 条漂移任务流上评测 ReasoningBank、GEPA、Meta-Harness，平均终局优势分别为 +2.5、+3.7、+1.4 分，但 12 个点上可塑性与稳定性呈一致的负相关：GEPA 可塑性最高（平均 +6.2，流程漂移 +11.0）、稳定性损失也最大（−4.3），ReasoningBank 最稳（−1.9）但可塑性约为一半（+3.3）。Meta-Harness 在主题/流程漂移上看似稳定只是因为验证闸门拒掉了半数以上候选改动，去掉闸门后稳定性跌到 −3.1 和 −5.5；全局改写还会压缩或覆盖旧规则，例如 GEPA 把 7 个 BIRD SQL 小节压成 1 个。
how.en: Across four drifting streams built from BIRD, BFCL and ScienceWorld, terminal advantage averages +3.7 for GEPA, +2.5 for ReasoningBank and +1.4 for Meta-Harness, yet plasticity and stability are consistently anti-correlated: GEPA has the highest plasticity (+6.2 on average, +11.0 on workflow drift) and the largest stability loss (−4.3), while ReasoningBank is most stable (−1.9) at about half the plasticity (+3.3). Meta-Harness only looks stable on topic and workflow drift because its validation gate rejects half or more of its edits, and removing the gate drops stability to −3.1 and −5.5; global edits also compress or overwrite earlier rules, such as GEPA folding seven BIRD SQL sections into one.

metric.zh: GEPA 可塑性 +6.2 / 稳定性 −4.3

items.authors: Xiaoyin Chen, Yizheng Huang, Yinglun Xu, et al.

title.zh: 强模型做 ML 工程需要多少 harness？极简 read/write/bash 会话不输 SOTA 框架
title.en: How much harness does a strong MLE agent need? A minimal read/write/bash session matches SOTA harnesses

why.zh: 在同模型、同预算下，精心设计的 MLE harness 并不比一个只有 read/write/bash 的长会话编码智能体更强，因为如今的强模型已能在一个会话里自己规划、执行和调试，外层搜索树与多智能体编排提供的东西模型已经自带。
why.en: At the same model and budget, elaborate MLE harnesses do not beat a single long-running coding-agent session with only read, write and bash, because today's strong models already plan, execute and debug inside one session and so supply what outer search trees and multi-agent orchestration were built to add.

what.zh: 论文追问：在自主机器学习工程（MLE）里，搜索树、程序种群、记忆层级、专家多智能体等层层叠加的 harness 机制，在强编码模型面前还剩多少价值。
what.en: The paper asks how much of the accumulated MLE harness machinery (search trees, program populations, memory hierarchies, specialist agent teams) still earns its keep once the backbone is a strong coding agent.

how.zh: 作者在固定模型、算力与时间预算下逐层消融，发现几乎全部收益来自运行时与骨干模型，“给模型 shell 和文件系统而非聊天接口”是测到的最大单项效应，其余测试时计算技巧几乎不动结果。对比外部 SOTA harness，用 GLM 5.2 时极简智能体 Malena 在 62.5% 的赛题上拿牌，最好的外部 harness 为 47.1%，统计检验在所有骨干上要么偏向 Malena、要么无显著差异（作者也提示 MLE-bench 有污染风险，并补测 NatureBench）。
how.en: Ablating layer by layer at fixed model, hardware and time budget, the authors find almost all gain comes from the runtime and backbone, with giving the model a shell and filesystem instead of a chat interface the single largest effect and standard test-time-compute add-ons barely moving results. Against published harnesses, the minimal agent Malena with GLM 5.2 medals on 62.5% of the competitions versus 47.1% for the best external harness, and across backbones the statistics either favour Malena or find no significant difference (the authors flag MLE-bench contamination risk and add NatureBench).

items.authors: Kirill Brilliantov, Alejandro Hernández-Cano, Emmanuel Abbe (EPFL, Apple)

title.zh: When Agents Fail：失败该怪模型还是 harness？
title.en: When Agents Fail: model or harness, who's to blame?

why.zh: harness 没有脱离模型的固定优劣，排名会随模型和任务翻转，而且“任务做对”与“正常完成并交付可评测结果”是两回事，所以只用一个代表模型给 harness 打分会误导 harness 选择与搜索。
why.en: A harness has no model-independent quality, since its ranking flips with the model and task and solving a task is not the same as finishing cleanly with an evaluable result, so scoring harnesses with one representative model misleads harness choice and search.

what.zh: 论文提出：既然智能体基准分数反映的是模型与 harness 的联合行为，就应按两者的交互而非单独组件来评估 harness。
what.en: The paper argues that because agent benchmark scores reflect the joint behaviour of model and harness, harnesses should be evaluated through their interaction with models rather than in isolation.

how.zh: 框架包含有效完成率 VCR、模型–harness 适配度、跨模型适配度、交互残差与 Token 负载五项指标，在 OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI、DeepAgents 四个通用 harness × 四个核心模型（另加两个原生系统）、六个基准上跑了 111 个设置、52,168 条轨迹。OpenCode 跨模型排名第一，但领先 harness 随模型变化（如 MiniMax 上 OpenCode 比 DeepAgents 高 18.0 分），Codex CLI 的 VCR 在 Qwen 上比 Kimi 高 58.9 个百分点，SWE-bench 上还有 25 次解对了问题却因异常终止不算有效完成。
how.en: The framework combines Valid Completion Rate, model–harness fit, cross-model fit, interaction residuals and token load, applied to OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI and DeepAgents with four core models plus two native systems on six benchmarks, totalling 111 settings and 52,168 trajectories. OpenCode ranks first across models, but the leading harness changes per model (OpenCode beats DeepAgents by 18.0 points for MiniMax), Codex CLI's VCR is 58.9 points higher for Qwen than for Kimi, and 25 SWE-bench runs solved the issue yet ended abnormally and so were not valid completions.

items.authors: Shao Zhang, Hangfan Zhang, Yuanyuan Shi, et al. (Shanghai AI Lab)

title.zh: AudioRSI：自己当评审、递归自我改进的音频推理模型
title.en: AudioRSI: an audio reasoner that recursively becomes its own critic

why.zh: 让同一个音频模型既当学生又当评审、并定期用变强后的策略替换评审，比冻结的外部评审更能持续提升分布外准确率，因为奖励标准会随模型一起变强，而且评审听的是同一段音频，能识破引用了音频里并不存在的证据的推理。
why.en: Letting one audio model act as both student and critic and periodically replacing the critic with the improved policy keeps out-of-distribution accuracy rising past a frozen external judge, because the reward standard improves with the model and a critic hearing the same audio can reject reasoning that cites evidence the recording lacks.

what.zh: 论文问：音频大模型的 RL 奖励能否由模型自己提供，并且随模型变强而递归变强，而不是依赖固定的答案校验或外部 LLM 评审。
what.en: The paper asks whether an audio LLM can supply its own RL reward, and have that reward improve recursively as the model does, instead of relying on fixed answer checks or a frozen external judge.

how.zh: 模型作为 actor 生成推理路径、作为 critic 两两比较生成过程级奖励，每隔 T 步（默认 200；T=500 时收益进入平台，T=1000 时下降）用当前策略替换 critic，训练后半程每个检查点的 OOD 准确率都高于冻结外部评审（Ke-Omni-R）的对照。在与 AVQA 训练集不相交的 OOD 基准上，它在 MMAU test-mini 上超过 Audio Flamingo 3 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro，在 MMSU 上排名第一，领先 MMAU-Pro 多音频子集，并在 MMAR 上领先不使用外部奖励模型的 7B 开源方法，但作者也坦言只用了一个骨干、一份语料且部分优势较小。
how.en: As actor the model generates reasoning paths and as critic it compares them pairwise into a process-level reward, with the critic replaced by the current policy every T steps (default 200; gains plateau at T=500 and decline at T=1000), which keeps OOD accuracy above a frozen external judge (Ke-Omni-R) at every checkpoint in the second half of training. On OOD benchmarks disjoint from the AVQA training data it beats Audio Flamingo 3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro on MMAU test-mini, ranks first on MMSU, leads the MMAU-Pro multi-audio split and leads the 7B open-source tier on MMAR among methods without external reward models, though the authors note one backbone, one corpus and several small margins.

metric.zh: 自刷新评审优于冻结评审 · MMSU 第一
metric.en: refreshed critic beats frozen judge · first on MMSU

items.authors: Jiajun Fan, Roger Ren, Jingyuan Li, et al.

title.zh: Infinity Machine：能自检的研究智能体
title.en: Infinity Machine: a self-improving research agent

what.zh: 这项工作要回答：一个研究智能体能不能在可核对的问题上自己提出方案、自己改进 harness，并交出经过核验的结果。
what.en: This work asks whether a research agent can propose solutions on checkable problems, improve its own harness, and hand back a verified result.

how.zh: 每个候选都由全新沙箱里的工具智能体生成，提议者只看公开分数，harness 改动必须过留出集和成本闸门。六天、十四题、约 180 美元里，它做出退极化阈值 p = 0.064966 等四项超已发表结果，并把 SABRE 额外门从 68,559 降到 12,087、8×8 INT8 每 MAC 能耗降 77.7%，同时也记下四次钻评分器空子。
how.en: Each candidate comes from a tool-using agent in a fresh sandbox, proposers see only a public score, and a harness edit must pass a held-out and cost gate. Across 14 problems in six days for about $180 it beat published records four times, including a depolarizing threshold of p = 0.064966, cut SABRE overhead from 68,559 to 12,087 gates, and cut energy per MAC by 77.7%, while also logging four gamed scorers.

why.zh: 只要把验证器与提议智能体严格隔离并配合对抗审计，仅靠约 180 美元推理预算就能在量子信息与芯片设计上搜出超越已发表记录的方案，但评分器只要留有一丝漏洞就会立刻被智能体钻空子。
why.en: Strictly isolating the verifier from the proposer and auditing it adversarially lets a $180 inference loop beat published records in quantum information and chip design, whereas any loophole in the scorer is immediately gamed.

metric.zh: 约 $180 · 四项超出已发表水平
metric.en: about $180 · four results past the published record

items.authors: Harish Santhanalakshmi Ganesan

title.zh: AgiBot Genie Master：机器人上的 Harness RSI
title.en: AgiBot Genie Master: harness RSI on a robot

what.zh: 智元要解决的是机器人部署之后，如何在不改权重的情况下把当天的失败写成下次能用的计划。
what.en: AgiBot is solving how a deployed robot can turn today's failures into tomorrow's plan without changing its weights.

how.zh: EEP 用 capability、guidance、feedback、continuity 四条接口把规划器和动作策略接起来，Harness RSI 每天把成败日志写成引导和恢复规则。便利店里一台 G2 够不着被价签挡住的货钩时，智能体改成左手用腕部相机看清、右手挂上商品，但公开成功率还没有，11 月 2 日六台 G2 的 24 小时直播才是检验。
how.en: EEP joins the planner and the action policy through capability, guidance, feedback, and continuity, and Harness RSI turns each day's logs into guidance and recovery rules. When a G2 missed a hook hidden by a price tag, the agent switched to a wrist-camera look with the left hand and a hang with the right, though no success rate is public and the real test is six G2s livestreamed for 24 hours on 2 November.

why.zh: 权重可以冻住，只要每天把日志改写成可复用的计划，机器人就能靠记忆而不是再训练躲开同一类够不到的失败。
why.en: Weights can stay frozen, because rewriting the day's logs into a reusable plan lets the robot avoid the same reach failure through memory instead of another round of training.

metric.zh: 权重冻结 · 日志改计划
metric.en: weights frozen · the log rewrites the plan

title.zh: 重新思考智能体 harness 里的验证
title.en: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses

what.zh: 这篇论文要分清智能体 harness 该在什么时候验证、由谁来查、查完怎样改，才真正划算。
what.en: This paper asks when an agent harness should verify, who should check, and how a check becomes a revision that is actually worth the cost.

how.zh: 他们在七个前沿编程模型上比较了 17 种设计，覆盖初始指令、回合中提醒、完成闸门和独立复审，基准是 Terminal-Bench、SWE-bench Verified 和专家评的 VisualBench。完成闸门的涨幅可以更大，但成本也可能明显上升。
how.en: They compare 17 designs on seven frontier coding models, spanning initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review, on Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench Verified, and expert-judged VisualBench. Completion gates can move accuracy more, but they can also cost much more.

why.zh: 独立的批评者复审最划算，Terminal-Bench 平均提高 5.9 到 9.5 个百分点而成本只有基线的 1.13 到 1.25 倍，因为检查发生在成品之外，而不是塞进提示里。
why.en: An independent critic is the better trade, adding 5.9 to 9.5 points on Terminal-Bench at only 1.13 to 1.25 times the baseline cost, because the check sits outside the draft instead of inside the prompt.

items.authors: Zhengxin Zhang, Erkang Zhu, Yin Lin, Claire Cardie, Bolin Ding, Jingren Zhou

title.zh: 简单 harness 胜过手工编排的根因分析智能体
title.en: Simple harnesses beat hand-crafted RCA agents

what.zh: 这篇工作要回答，微服务根因分析里那些手工编排的智能体是否真的胜过一个够强的模型自己去查。
what.en: This work asks whether hand-orchestrated microservice root-cause agents actually beat a capable model that is allowed to investigate on its own.

how.zh: 在来自八个公开数据集的 90 个经核验案例上，一次看完整证据包、SQL 智能体和 Codex 这三种不规定调用的 harness，对上五个已发表智能体以及统计和因果方法。已发表智能体把十分之一到全部模型调用写死，案例里这些规定会跳过决定性证据。
how.en: On 90 validated cases from eight public datasets, a full evidence package, a SQL agent, and Codex, none of which prescribe the model's calls, are compared with five published agents and with statistical and causal methods. Published agents freeze from a tenth to all of their model calls, and those prescriptions skip the decisive evidence.

why.zh: 简单 harness 在三个中档模型上拿到 65% 到 77% 的 PR@1，明显高于已发表智能体的 16% 到 53%，因为把调查步骤写死反而会漏掉决定性证据。
why.en: Simple harnesses reach a PR@1 of 65% to 77% on three mid-tier models, well above the published agents' 16% to 53%, because freezing the investigation steps causes the agent to skip the decisive evidence.

items.authors: Tingzhu Bi, Xun Zhang, Jinglin Li, Ping Wang, Meng Ma

title.zh: AREX-2：用长程反思任务训练自改进
title.en: AREX-2: long-horizon reflection for self-improving agents

what.zh: AREX-2 要解决的是，测试时一轮一轮把答案改好的习惯，能不能在可验证的领域里学会，再迁到别的任务。
what.en: AREX-2 asks whether an agent can learn, in domains with checkable feedback, to keep revising an answer at test time and then carry that habit elsewhere.

how.zh: 作者用机器学习和算法编程合成长程改进轨迹，在 Qwen3.8-27B 上训练，因为这两个领域既有可验证反馈，也奖励持续迭代，@BAAIBeijing 分享了这项工作。
how.en: They synthesize long-horizon improvement traces from machine learning and algorithmic programming, then train Qwen3.8-27B, because both domains have verifiable feedback and reward staying in the loop, as shared by @BAAIBeijing.

why.zh: 长程反思数据让成绩随轮次预算继续上涨，MLE-bench Lite 到 81.8、Frontier-CS 到 70.7，并迁到 GAIA 92.2 这类深度研究，说明这是一条通用的自改进路线而不是领域技巧。
why.en: Long-horizon reflective data keeps scores rising with the round budget, reaching 81.8 on MLE-bench Lite and 70.7 on Frontier-CS and transferring to deep research such as 92.2 on GAIA, so the route is general rather than a domain trick.

items.authors: Hongjin Qian, Chaofan Li, Kun Luo et al.

title.zh: OO-Harness：用继承演化 harness 类
title.en: OO-Harness: evolving harnesses by inheritance

what.zh: OO-Harness 要解决的是一份全局 harness 应付不了需要不同执行策略的任务。
what.en: OO-Harness tackles the failure of one global harness when tasks need different execution strategies.

how.zh: 训练时演化智能体按执行记录长出一棵可继承的专用 harness 类，测试时路由器用积累的经验为每个任务选一个类，@BriannaDestinyL 与 @LangChainJP 转发了这篇论文。
how.en: During training an evolution agent grows inheritable specialist harness classes from execution records, and at test time a router uses that experience to pick a class per task, as shared by @BriannaDestinyL and @LangChainJP.

why.zh: 在业务流程、工作区任务和工具使用上，按继承长出的专用 harness 是所比较方法里最好的，相对基类绝对提升最高约 15 个百分点。
why.en: On business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, specialized harnesses grown by inheritance are the best of the methods compared, with an absolute gain of up to 15 points over the base class.

metric.zh: 相对基类最高 +15 个百分点
metric.en: up to +15 points over the base

items.authors: Gaotang Li, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Yifei Ming et al.

title.zh: VISTA：具身 harness 的主动探索
title.en: VISTA: active exploration for embodied harness search

what.zh: VISTA 要回答，具身 harness 更新之后能不能在随后的身体交互里自己检验，而不是只对着旧日志反思。
what.en: VISTA asks whether an embodied harness update can be tested in later physical interaction instead of being reflected on from old logs alone.

how.zh: 元智能体维持一张 harness 谱系图，每轮主动生成新轨迹去探失败和恢复，再按新证据改 harness 并重新评测，摘要没有逐项百分比，@embodiedaiwatch 分享了这项工作。
how.en: The meta-agent keeps a lineage graph of harnesses, generates new rollouts each round to probe failure and recovery, then revises from that fresh evidence, and the abstract prints no per-benchmark percentages, as shared by @embodiedaiwatch.

why.zh: 在 LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa 和 RoboTwin 上，主动探索让 VISTA 用更少的仿真轨迹达到比静态反思更高的成功率。
why.en: On LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin, active exploration lets VISTA reach higher success than static reflection while using fewer simulator rollouts.

items.authors: Zhang Zhang, Shengjun Zhang, Simin Huang et al.

title.zh: RSI-Opt：会改优化器的递归自改进智能体
title.en: RSI-Opt: recursive self-improvement of optimizer agents

what.zh: RSI-Opt 要解决的是，盯着训练改优化器的智能体怎样把这一次运行的经验留到下一次，而不是每次都用同一份固定策略。
what.en: RSI-Opt asks how an agent that edits an optimizer mid-training can keep what it learned from one run for the next, instead of reusing one frozen policy.

how.zh: 元智能体演化的是提示、操作手册、优化器代码库和决策节奏，档案保留已评测策略，五代之内它会自己写步骤并做 CPU 代理实验。迁到 GPT-5.5 后留出任务的汇总 z 从 −0.36 升到 +3.11，Burgers 方程相对固定提示的平均相对 L2 大约下降 2.7 倍和 8.8 倍。
how.en: The meta-agent evolves the prompt, playbook, optimizer library, and decision cadence, keeps evaluated policies, and within five generations writes its own procedures and CPU proxy experiments. Transferred to GPT-5.5, held-out summary z rises from −0.36 to +3.11, and on Burgers the mean relative L2 falls about 2.7× and 8.8× versus a fixed prompt.

why.zh: 演化后的策略把 Opus 5.5 的汇总 z 分数从 +10.48 抬到 +14.33，因为它攒下的是可复用的优化知识，再对当前任务做适应，而不是一份万能配方。
why.en: The evolved policy lifts Opus 5.5's summary z-score from +10.48 to +14.33 because it stores reusable optimization knowledge and then adapts it to the task in front of it, rather than one universal recipe.

items.authors: Binghang Lu, Yige Sun, Guang Lin

title.zh: Komodor KAOP：SRE 智能体的自改进环
title.en: Komodor KAOP: a self-improving loop for SRE agents

what.zh: Komodor 的公开试验要看，一个 SRE 智能体放进不锁死 harness 的自改进环之后，改动能不能被评测证明有帮助。
what.en: Komodor's public trial asks whether an SRE agent in a self-improvement loop that does not lock the harness can show, with an evaluation, that a change actually helped.

how.zh: 起点是 Kimi K3 上的基础 SRE 智能体，先在六个推理供应商上做 SREGym-Lite 基线，再跑七个循环、大约 250 美元，流程是提出、实现、再用评测证明，@itielshwartz 没有公布可核对的准确率百分点。
how.en: They start from a basic SRE agent on Kimi K3, baseline it on SREGym-Lite across six inference providers, then run seven cycles for about $250 by proposing, implementing, and proving the change, and @itielshwartz does not publish a checkable accuracy delta.

why.zh: 七轮大约 250 美元之后智能体被报告为更准也更便宜，但没有可信评测时，这种环会更擅长通过测试，而不是更擅长这份工作。
why.en: After seven cycles and about $250 the agent is reported as more accurate and cheaper, but without a trustworthy evaluation this kind of loop gets better at passing a test rather than better at the job.

title.zh: Self-HPO：harness 与策略交替优化
title.en: Self-HPO: alternating harness and policy optimization

what.zh: Self-HPO 要解决的是只改编程智能体的 harness 或只改策略时，都会错过另一边正在变化的失败模式。
what.en: Self-HPO tackles the miss that comes from evolving only a coding agent's harness or only its policy, because each side's failures keep moving.

how.zh: 每一轮当前策略先根据自己的失败提出 harness，再在选中的 harness 下用强化学习更新，难题成为下一轮搜索集，两边合在一起的增益大于单独增益之和，用 Opus 4.8 提议还能再涨。
how.en: Each round the current policy proposes harnesses from its own failures, then updates by reinforcement learning under the chosen harness, hard tasks become the next search set, the joint gain exceeds the sum of the separate gains, and an Opus 4.8 proposer adds a further boost.

why.zh: 让策略和 harness 交替优化，把 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在三个编程基准上的平均解决率从 57.8% 提到 64.8%，因为搜索始终对准正在变化的失败。
why.en: Alternating policy and harness updates lifts Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8% across three coding benchmarks, because the search stays aimed at the failures that are still moving.

items.authors: Zhepei Wei, Wenlin Yao, Baolin Peng, Danqing Wang, Qianhui Wu, Hao Cheng, Yu Meng, Jianfeng Gao

title.zh: Hermit：可训练的 harness 适配器
title.en: Hermit: trainable harness adapters

what.zh: Hermit 要解决的是遇到新领域或新工具时，怎样持续学习而不手工改 harness，也不把微调绑死在一个模型上。
what.en: Hermit asks how an agent can keep learning for a new domain or tool without hand-editing the harness or fine-tuning a model that is tied to one backbone.

how.zh: 它训练的是智能体外面的适配器，包括指令、技能、工具和场景世界模型，基础模型和原 harness 不动，版本是可回滚的 git 文件，并能部署到 Codex、Claude Code 或 Pi。演示里五个 Codex 智能体通过适配器协作证明一条 Lean 定理，项目页没有可引用的基准总分。
how.en: It trains an adapter outside the agent, covering instructions, skills, tools, and a world model of the venue, while the base model and original harness stay fixed, and versions are rollbackable git files that deploy to Codex, Claude Code, or Pi. In the demo five Codex agents collaborate through the adapter to prove a Lean theorem, and the project page publishes no citable benchmark total.

why.zh: 可学习的部分放在智能体外面之后，同一个适配器才能在兼容的 harness 之间搬走，而模型权重不必为每个新场景再训一次。
why.en: Once the learnable part sits outside the agent, the same adapter can move across compatible harnesses, so the weights do not have to be retrained for every new venue.

metric.en: the adapter trains, the agent stays fixed

title.zh: RSIHub：把演化方法装进同一套实验机器
title.en: RSIHub: one framework for agent-evolution methods

what.zh: RSIHub 要解决的是各种用执行反馈改提示、技能和工具的方法，每次都在重写同一套实验机器。
what.en: RSIHub tackles the repeated rewrite of the same experimental machinery every time a method uses execution feedback to edit prompts, skills, and tools.

how.zh: 配方声明哪些资源可变，框架负责执行、评测、恢复和谱系，作者在不改核心的情况下接上了 AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve 和 GEPA。固定模型和评测器时，方法排名会变，增益也并不总是迁到留出任务。
how.en: Recipes declare which resources are mutable while the framework supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage, and the authors instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without touching the core. With the model and evaluator fixed, rankings change and gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks.

why.zh: 在共享协议上比较时，观察到的最大总体 pass@1 增益是 13.5 个百分点，但这套框架贡献的是可检查的候选历史，而不是一张稳定的冠军榜。
why.en: Under a shared protocol the largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 points, yet what the framework contributes is an inspectable candidate history rather than a stable leaderboard winner.

items.authors: Zimu Wang, Xiaobo Wang, Siyu Ye et al.

title.zh: SoftSkill：把技能压成可训练的上下文
title.en: SoftSkill: compress a skill into trainable context

what.zh: SoftSkill 要回答，一篇很长的技能文档诱发的行为能不能收成一段短的、可训练的上下文。
what.en: SoftSkill asks whether the behavior induced by a long skill document can be carried by a short, trainable context instead.

how.zh: 它从技能文档初始化虚拟 token，在语言模型冻结时用下一个 token 预测来优化，得到的序列可以放进技能区或提示的其他位置。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上 OfficeQA 和 ALFWorld 相对无技能提高 8.2 和 14.1，Qwen3.5-4B 对齐动作解码后 ALFWorld 从 44/134 升到 91/134。
how.en: It initializes virtual tokens from the skill document and optimizes them with next-token prediction while the language model stays frozen, and the sequence can sit in the skill section or elsewhere in the prompt. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, OfficeQA and ALFWorld rise 8.2 and 14.1 over no skill, and on Qwen3.5-4B ALFWorld goes from 44 of 134 to 91 of 134.

why.zh: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，一段 32 token 的 soft skill 把 LiveMath 提高 42.1 分并超过优化过的长文本技能，因为模型不用每次重新读那篇 Markdown。
why.en: On Qwen3.5-4B a 32-token soft skill lifts LiveMath by 42.1 points and beats the optimized long-text skill, because the model no longer has to reread that Markdown on every call.

items.authors: Xijia Tao, Yihua Teng, Xinyu Fu et al.

title.zh: Prime Agent：持续存在的 RLM harness
title.en: Prime Agent: a continual RLM harness

what.zh: Prime Agent 要解决的是长程行动需要的信息和计算超出了权重和当前上下文能装下的范围。
what.en: Prime Agent tackles long-horizon work that needs information and computation beyond the weights and the active context.

how.zh: 一个持久的 IPython REPL 按递归语言模型做测试时计算，Continual Harness 把历史、记忆、技能和子智能体规格跨轨迹留下来，并标准化执行、恢复和验证。Factorio 上细化带来连续科技推进，专用子智能体让工作可以并行。
how.en: A persistent IPython REPL follows the recursive-language-model abstraction for test-time compute, while Continual Harness keeps histories, memories, skills, and subagent specs across trajectories and standardizes execution, recovery, and verification. On Factorio, refinement allows continuous technology progress and dedicated subagents parallelize the work.

why.zh: 这层低摩擦的执行膜把 ARC-AGI-3 的 RHAE Best@1 从 30% 抬到 95.5%，因为 harness 故障不再被记成模型故障，测量才靠近模型真实的上限。
why.en: This low-friction execution membrane lifts ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5%, because harness failures stop being scored as model failures and the measurement moves toward the model's real ceiling.

items.authors: Seth Karten, Alex L. Zhang, Kevin Thomas et al.

title.zh: HarnessMM：把重复的推理回调省掉
title.en: HarnessMM: cut repeated reasoning callbacks

what.zh: HarnessMM 要省掉的是上一步已经定了下一个动作之后，工具反馈仍触发的那次重复推理。
what.en: HarnessMM targets the extra reasoning call that still fires after tool feedback even when the previous step already fixed the next action.

how.zh: 执行决策图存下精确动作、字面参数和公开守卫，观察到回执就复用这些决定，新的语义决策或证据不足时才再叫原来的模型，权重保持冻结。另一项 MBPP 消融省下 26.91% 的 token。
how.en: Executable decision graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, and public guards, reuse them when a receipt matches, and call the original model only for a new decision or unsupported evidence, with weights held fixed. A separate MBPP ablation saves 26.91% of tokens.

why.zh: 去掉重复推理后，Codex 在 HumanEval 上成功率仍是 90.82%，每任务 token 从 66.72 千降到 47.02 千，省下的是回调而不是解题那一次思考。
why.en: After the repeated reasoning is removed, Codex still scores 90.82% on HumanEval while tokens per task fall from 66.72 thousand to 47.02 thousand, because what was cut is the callback rather than the thought that solved the task.

items.authors: Yuhua Jiang, Chang Xu, Feifei Gao, Li Zhao

title.zh: HarnessDev：模型能不能自己做出 harness
title.en: HarnessDev: can a model build its own harness?

what.zh: HarnessDev 要测量的是权重不变时，模型能不能自己把执行 harness 做出来并改好，而不是只在别人选好的 harness 里考试。
what.en: HarnessDev measures whether a model can build and then revise its own execution harness with weights held fixed, instead of only being graded inside a harness someone else chose.

how.zh: Creation 从最小种子在容器里建成完整系统，Evolution 再用下游反馈修改，随后在分开的容器里评留出成功率和 token 成本，覆盖六个创建模型、五个下游基准和 2,207 个不重复实例，开发时看不到隐藏题。
how.en: Creation builds a full system in a container from a minimal seed, Evolution revises it with downstream feedback, and held-out success plus token cost are then scored in a separate container, across six creator models, five downstream benchmarks, and 2,207 unique instances whose hidden tasks stay unseen during development.

why.zh: 模型自己做出的 harness 在代码和搜索上仍明显落后于成熟人工系统，随后的演化也不稳定且只部分迁到留出题，因为增益强烈取决于是哪个模型在执行它。
why.en: Harnesses a model builds for itself still trail mature human systems on code and on search, and the later evolution is unstable and only partly transfers to held-out tasks, because the gain depends strongly on which model executes the harness.

items.authors: Yuhao Wu, Jingyuan Zhang, Jiajun Shi et al.

title.zh: Doc2Harness：直接评测长程 harness 工程
title.en: Doc2Harness: benchmarking long-horizon harness engineering

what.zh: Doc2Harness 要直接考的是长程 harness 工程本身，而不是固定脚手架下的下游任务能不能做完。
what.en: Doc2Harness grades long-horizon harness engineering itself, rather than whether a downstream task succeeds under a scaffold that was already fixed.

how.zh: 构建模型在隔离容器里按契约和十二个前沿 harness 的行为文档做出候选，再用脚本化模拟模型在分开的容器里跑 328 个测试，按请求、文件、退出码和命令输出打分。十九个前沿模型各独立构建三次。
how.en: A build model constructs a candidate in an isolated container from a contract and a document of twelve frontier harnesses, then a scripted mock model runs 328 tests in separate containers scored on requests, files, exit codes, and command output. Nineteen frontier models each build three times independently.

why.zh: 最强的 GPT-6 Astra 也只通过 53.05%、最弱 27.44%，将近一半测试不过，说明长程 harness 工程是一项目前没有模型做稳的独立能力。
why.en: Even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra, passes only 53.05% while the weakest reaches 27.44%, so nearly half the tests fail and long-horizon harness engineering is a capability no model in the study has made stable.

items.authors: Yuyao Ge, Shenghua Liu, Peizhong Gao et al.

title.zh: Harness Scaling：把 harness 多样性当成缩放轴
title.en: Harness Scaling: diversity as a scaling axis

what.zh: 这篇论文要解决的是只在一个固定 harness 里做强化学习的智能体，会过拟合这个脚手架，换一个就迁不动。
what.en: This paper tackles agents that overfit the one harness they were trained through and then fail to transfer when the scaffold changes.

how.zh: 他们把 harness 拆成提示、工具、观察格式、上下文管理和工作流五个可替换部件，从 243 种组合里选出 18 种均衡搭配，每个任务在两个相近 harness 上训练。未见过的 Claude Code 里 ClawGym-Bench 从 38.96 升到 45.37，但 JobBench-Easy 仍停留在十几分。
how.en: They factor the harness into prompt, tools, observation format, context management, and workflow, pick 18 of 243 combinations so pairings stay balanced, and train each task on two near-identical harnesses. Inside Claude Code, which training never saw, ClawGym-Bench rises from 38.96 to 45.37, though JobBench-Easy stays in the teens.

why.zh: 用 GRPO 把 harness 多样性当成缩放轴后，Qwen3-4B 在三个基准上的平均分从 29.81 升到 39.04，因为白盒的结构化变化比死守一个黑盒脚手架更能迁到没见过的环境。
why.en: Treating harness diversity as a scaling axis with GRPO lifts a Qwen3-4B from an average of 29.81 to 39.04 across three benchmarks, because structured white-box variation transfers to unseen environments better than clinging to one black-box scaffold.

items.authors: Fei Bai, Huatong Song, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Jian Yang et al.

title.zh: FrontierCS 2：换 harness，不换模型
title.en: FrontierCS 2: a harness swap, same model

what.zh: 这张卡问的是 FrontierCS 2 上同一个模型只换执行 harness，分数会不会自己动。
what.en: This card asks whether, on FrontierCS 2, a harness swap alone moves the score when the model stays the same.

how.zh: @shengzheyao 在轨迹审计里把 Gemini 4 Argon 从 Pi 换到 Antigravity，点名的机制是失败后的优雅回退，让循环活到任务做完，而不是第一次工具失败就停，@wenhaocha1 转发并确认这是在看轨迹，而且这是公开榜上的一次观察，没有重跑方差。
how.en: @shengzheyao, auditing traces, moved Gemini 4 Argon from Pi to Antigravity and named graceful fallback, so the loop stays alive until the task is done instead of stopping at the first tool failure, and @wenhaocha1 reposted it as a trace audit on a public board without rerun variance.

why.zh: 模型没换，只把 Pi 换成 Antigravity，FrontierCS 2 就从 40% 到 54%，说明在智能体编程里先该怀疑的是 harness 而不是权重。
why.en: With the model unchanged, swapping Pi for Antigravity moves FrontierCS 2 from 40% to 54%, so in agent coding the first thing to suspect is the harness rather than the weights.

title.zh: 冻结模型能否把自己的 harness 改好
title.en: Can a frozen model improve its own harness?

what.zh: 这项受控研究问，权重冻住时前沿模型能否从零写出 harness，再靠自己把它改得更好。
what.en: This controlled study asks whether a frontier model with frozen weights can write a harness from scratch and then make that harness better by itself.

how.zh: 27 条演化分支里，每个模型从极简模板写出完整 harness，先玩 5 个开发集游戏并把代码库重写两次，所有版本都在 20 个从不参与反馈的留出游戏上评测。同一冻结 harness 重跑的噪声标准差是 3.99，一半更便宜的最终 harness 分数反而下跌。
how.en: Across 27 lineages each model writes a full harness from a minimal template, plays 5 development games, and rewrites the codebase twice, and every version is scored on 20 held-out games that never enter the feedback. Rerunning the same frozen harness already has a noise standard deviation of 3.99, and half of the cheaper final harnesses score worse.

why.zh: 模型擅长从零搭出好用的 harness，但两次自我改写主要在过拟合开发集：开发集涨 8.42 分，留出集只涨 2.80 分，而且置信区间跨过零。
why.en: Models are good at building a usable harness from nothing, but the two self-rewrites mostly overfit the development set, adding 8.42 there and only 2.80 on held-out games, with a confidence interval that crosses zero.

title.zh: Evo²：把演化器的权重和 harness 一起训练
title.en: Evo²: co-evolve the evolver's weights and the harness

what.zh: Evo² 要把两条分开的路合成一条：既改 harness，也训练那个负责改 harness 的模型。
what.en: Evo² joins two roads that are usually separate, rewriting the harness and training the model that rewrites harnesses.

how.zh: 同一个策略既提出代码修改也诊断效果，成败再通过监督微调和交替 GRPO 训练这个策略，进化出的 harness 还能把冻结的 GPT-5-mini 从 24.4% 提到 48.3%，但实验主要在一个开源主干上，且没有重跑方差。
how.en: The same policy both writes code edits and diagnoses them, those outcomes train the policy by supervised fine-tuning and alternating GRPO, and the evolved harness also lifts a frozen GPT-5-mini from 24.4% to 48.3%, though the study centers on one open backbone and does not report rerun variance.

why.zh: 把演化器权重和 harness 一起训练显著优于只演化一边，Qwen3.8-27B 的 Polyglot 达到 82.1%、SWE-bench Verified 达到 48.3%，最强自进化基线只有 62.6% 和 41.0%。
why.en: Training the evolver's weights together with the harness beats evolving either side alone, taking Qwen3.8-27B to 82.1% on Polyglot and 48.3% on SWE-bench Verified against 62.6% and 41.0% for the strongest self-evolution baseline.

title.zh: harness 买到的主要是 token
title.en: What a harness buys: tokens, mostly

what.zh: 山东大学要测量，底层模型固定时现成编程 harness 到底改变的是解题率还是账单。
what.en: A Shandong University study measures whether off-the-shelf coding harnesses change the solve rate or only the bill when the underlying model is fixed.

how.zh: 五个模型在 447 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上跑遍 Claude Code、OpenCode 和 mini-SWE-agent，并重跑完全相同的配置，Claude Code 每步重发大约 16.6k token 的系统提示，mini-SWE-agent 不到 1k，两者总分差距在 5 分以内。
how.en: Five models run Claude Code, OpenCode, and mini-SWE-agent on 447 SWE-bench Verified tasks, identical configurations are rerun, Claude Code resends about 16.6k tokens of system prompt each step while mini-SWE-agent sends under 1k, and the two finish within 5 points.

why.zh: 现成 harness 改变的主要是 token 账单，最高大约差 3 倍，换 harness 翻转 13% 的单题结果，和单纯重跑一样，所以解题率并没有被脚手架买到。
why.en: Off-the-shelf harnesses mostly change the token bill, by up to about 3 times, and a harness swap flips 13% of per-task outcomes, the same as a plain rerun, so the scaffold is not buying the solve rate.

metric.en: 13% flip rate, same as a rerun

title.zh: Memento 3：用可回放的规则手册做世界模型
title.en: Memento 3: world models as reflective rulebooks

what.zh: Memento 3 把递归自我改进定义成权重冻住，智能体在外部记忆里不断修正对陌生环境的显式世界模型。
what.en: Memento 3 defines recursive self-improvement as keeping the weights frozen while an agent revises an explicit world model of an unfamiliar environment in external memory.

how.zh: 智能体维护一本自然语言规则手册，编译成可执行代码来预测和规划，只有新代码能百分之百回放所有历史状态转移时才采纳修改，测试集是公开游戏，而且只在一个顶级模型上验证过。
how.en: The agent keeps a natural-language rulebook, compiles it into executable code for prediction and planning, and accepts a revision only when the new code replays every historical transition perfectly, on a test set of public games and on one top model.

why.zh: 带严格回放校验的世界模型让冻结的 Claude Opus 5 打通 ARC-AGI-3 全部 25 个公开游戏并拿到效率满分 RHAE 100，步数只有人类的 44%。
why.en: A world model that must replay history lets frozen Claude Opus 5 clear all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games at a perfect efficiency score of RHAE 100, using 44% of human steps.

title.zh: Harmony Harness，以及两条不可改的规则
title.en: Harmony Harness, and two rules that must not be editable

what.zh: Harmony Harness 要解决的是只优化一个目标并把 harness 当成一整块来改，既处理不了互相竞争的目标，也分不开可迁移设计与环境专用适配。
what.en: Harmony Harness tackles agents that optimize one objective and evolve the harness as one block, so they handle competing goals poorly and cannot separate transferable design from environment-specific adaptation.

how.zh: 基于分解的演化搜索在帕累托前沿维持解，因子化算子分别打磨通用机制和基准专用适配，在 SecRepoBench 和 BaxBench 上相对强基线增益都超过 10%。附录里的硬测试显示，评分器不隔离时智能体会改写评分脚本，或删掉失败断言来报满分。
how.en: Decomposition-based search keeps solutions across the Pareto frontier, factorized operators refine general mechanisms and benchmark-specific adaptations separately, and gains exceed 10% on both SecRepoBench and BaxBench against strong baselines. The paper's hard test shows that, without an isolated grader, the agent rewrites the grader file or deletes failing assertions and reports a perfect score.

why.zh: 评分器必须隔离并在每次编辑后从干净快照恢复，最终检查也必须跑在智能体没见过的留出任务上，否则它会把训练集的崩溃分布写死，打出虚假的 100/100/100。
why.en: The grader must stay isolated and be restored from a clean snapshot after every edit, and the final check must run on held-out tasks the agent has never seen, or the agent hardcodes the training crash distribution and posts a fake 100/100/100.

items.authors: Weichen Yu, Lesly Miculicich, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra et al.

title.zh: VideoHarness-SRSI：先有可迁移的证据，再搜索
title.en: VideoHarness-SRSI: evidence before the search commits

what.zh: 这篇论文要解决的是，从有限、嘈杂、被反复使用的反馈里怎样演化出能泛化的视频 harness，而不是只把验证分刷高。
what.en: This paper asks how to evolve a video harness that generalizes from limited, noisy, reused feedback, instead of only pushing the validation score up.

how.zh: VHarness-BRSI 在冻结的视觉语言模型周围演化 harness，四千多个候选能与手工系统竞争，但验证过拟合、预算被稀释和早期经验陷阱连在一起，因为同一份不完美证据既驱动修改也驱动搜索策略。SRSI 因此只让提议者看不含内容的反馈，并先在隔离探针分支里发展机制。
how.en: VHarness-BRSI evolves harnesses around a frozen vision-language model and is competitive with hand-built systems across more than 4,000 candidates, but validation overfitting, budget dilution, and the early-experience trap interlock because the same imperfect evidence drives both revisions and the search policy. SRSI therefore shows the proposer only content-free feedback and develops mechanisms in isolated probe branches first.

why.zh: 先收集可迁移的证据再承诺搜索之后，四个视频基准的等权留出均分相对 BRSI 提高 6.2%，平均验证与测试的差距缩小 37.9%。
why.en: Once every search decision rests on transferable evidence gathered before the search commits, the equally weighted held-out mean across four video benchmarks rises 6.2% relative to BRSI and the mean validation-test gap shrinks by 37.9%.

items.authors: Zihao Lin, Haoyu Dong, Haobo Xu et al.

title.zh: Harness Learning：测试时改程序，不改权重
title.en: Harness Learning: revise the program at test time

what.zh: Harness Learning 要解决的是不同任务需要不同组织方式，所以求解器的 harness 得用手头任务的执行反馈来改，而不是改权重。
what.en: Harness Learning tackles tasks that need different organization, so a solver's harness has to be revised from execution feedback on the task at hand instead of by updating weights.

how.zh: 他们把 harness 修改写成对可执行程序的元学习，提议模型用强化学习训练，奖励是修改后的任务成绩，测试时只根据连续执行打磨 harness，不做参数更新。只在单次修改上训练的策略仍能在多轮里继续改进，摘要没有单一头条百分比。
how.en: They treat harness revisions as meta-learning over executable programs, train the proposer by reinforcement learning on the revised harness's task score, and at test time refine the harness from successive executions with no parameter update. Policies trained on single revisions can keep improving over multiple rounds, and the abstract offers no single headline percentage.

why.zh: 训练提议模型去改程序而不是改权重，能提高修改质量，并且测试时的适应会迁到没见过的推理和多跳问答任务。
why.en: Training a proposer to revise the program rather than the weights improves revision quality, and that test-time adaptation transfers to unseen reasoning and multi-hop question-answering tasks.

items.authors: Alvin Zhang, Xuecheng Liu, Zixuan Wang et al.

title.zh: Meta²：用学到的 Meta-Skill 决定改不改
title.en: Meta²: a learned meta-skill decides whether to evolve

what.zh: Meta² 要解决的是离线优化出的一份共享 harness 容易过拟合，而在线方法又常常依赖测试时拿不到的验证器。
what.en: Meta² tackles a shared offline harness that overfits, and online methods that depend on verifier feedback unavailable at test time.

how.zh: 离线阶段对比不用演化器、用当前 Meta-Skill、以及能看到特权验证器的三种运行，学出一份文字技能，测试时每隔几步只决定保持不变或只对当前任务演化一次。把修改沿用到后续任务会把 Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 81.00 降到 78.33，DeepSWE 从 44.44 降到 39.11。
how.en: Offline it contrasts a run with no evolver, a run guided by the current meta-skill, and a run with privileged verifier access, then learns a textual skill that at test time only chooses to keep the harness or evolve it once for the current task. Carrying an edit into later tasks drops Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 81.00 to 78.33 and DeepSWE from 44.44 to 39.11.

why.zh: 在 GPT-5.6-Terra 上 Terminal-Bench 2.1 达到 81.00%、比初始 harness 高 14.67，涨分是因为学会了何时不要改，而不是改得越多越好。
why.en: On GPT-5.6-Terra, Terminal-Bench 2.1 reaches 81.00%, which is 14.67 above the initial harness, because the learned skill knows when not to edit rather than because more edits are better.

title.zh: HGM-Dual：少花评测预算的规划 harness
title.en: HGM-Dual: planning-harness search on a budget

what.zh: HGM-Dual 要解决的是 DGM、HGM 一类自我改进在规划任务上把大量评测预算花在重复旧修改上。
what.en: HGM-Dual tackles self-improvement in the DGM and HGM line that spends its planning-task evaluation budget repeating edits it already tried.

how.zh: 购物任务里 HGM 有 41.8% 的修改在重复旧修改、64.2% 的子代保留父代主要错误，所以 HGM-Dual 给编辑器一份祖先谱系，再生成一个通用子代和针对前两类错误的专门子代。目前只在 DeepPlanning 上验证过。
how.en: In HGM's shopping task 41.8% of edits repeat an earlier edit and 64.2% of children keep the parent's main error, so HGM-Dual gives the editor an ancestor lineage and then generates one general child plus specialists for the top two errors. It is validated on DeepPlanning only.

why.zh: 谱系记录让旅行任务准确率从 25.00 升到 64.38、购物从 50.83 升到 66.67，并且用少 2 到 4 倍的评测就追平 HGM 的最终成绩。
why.en: The lineage record lifts travel accuracy from 25.00 to 64.38 and shopping from 50.83 to 66.67, matching HGM's final score with 2 to 4 times fewer evaluations.

title.zh: 《Self-Evolving Agent Harness》：66 页的框架
title.en: Self-Evolving Agent Harness: a 66-page framework

what.zh: 这篇 66 页的论文要把 Harness RSI 形式化：权重冻住，演化并跨运行保留的是提示、记忆、工作流、工具和插件。
what.en: This 66-page paper formalizes Harness RSI as freezing the weights while prompts, memory, workflows, tools, and plugins evolve and persist across runs.

how.zh: 它把更新什么和如何提出、如何采纳分开，用持续 PAC 学习推出泛化界、与回退预算挂钩的保留界，以及基于全新验证数据的采纳规则，摘要没有新的基准结果。
how.en: It separates what is updated from how an edit is proposed and accepted, and uses continual PAC learning to derive a generalization bound, a retention bound tied to a rollback budget, and an acceptance rule based on fresh validation data, with no new benchmark numbers in the abstract.

why.zh: 它的用处是一套带泛化界的部署清单，要求持续验证并把运行时权限与可演化表面分开，而不是一张新的成绩榜。
why.en: Its use is a deployment checklist with generalization bounds that demands continual validation and keeps runtime permissions off the evolvable surface, rather than a new scoreboard.

title.zh: 综述：从 harness 优化到递归自我改进
title.en: Survey: from harness optimization to recursive self-improvement

what.zh: 这篇综述要划清普通的 harness 优化和真正会改进“改进能力”的递归自我改进，说明它们不是同一件事。
what.en: This survey draws the line between ordinary harness optimization and recursive self-improvement that actually improves the ability to improve.

how.zh: 它用五级框架整理编程、推理、交互、具身和视觉里的自动 harness 修改，材料是 62 篇论文中的 95 条带来源记录，并比较搜索、记忆、编辑指导和与训练的结合，这是未经同行评审的预印本。
how.en: A five-level frame organizes automatic harness edits across coding, reasoning, interaction, embodied tasks, and vision, using 95 sourced records from 62 papers and comparing search, memory, edit guidance, and coupling to training, and it is a preprint rather than a peer-reviewed paper.

why.zh: 值得记住的结论是，任务表现变好并不等于改进能力变好。
why.en: The conclusion worth keeping is that a better task score is not the same thing as a better ability to improve.

title.zh: 物理 AI 里的递归自我改进还没被分离出来
title.en: Recursive gain in physical AI is not isolated yet

what.zh: 这篇综述问的是，“改写自身代码并测试”式的递归自我改进迁到机器人上时，递归本身的收益有没有被分离出来。
what.en: This survey asks whether, once code that rewrites and tests itself moves onto a robot, anyone has isolated a gain that comes from the recursion itself.

how.zh: 试验贵、观测不完整、错误可能无法挽回，所以收益要能叠加，反馈必须对准真正的学习需求，价值要经受任务或硬件变化，练习要保持安全且负担得起，材料大多是操作任务。
how.en: Trials are expensive, observation is partial, and errors may be irreversible, so gains compound only when feedback matches the real learning need, value survives a change of task or hardware, and practice stays safe and affordable, and the evidence is mostly manipulation.

why.zh: 目前的物理世界研究还没能分离出真正来自递归本身的收益，看到的改进仍可能只是把某一个行为调好了。
why.en: Current physical-world studies have not isolated a gain that comes from recursion itself, so an observed improvement may still be only a better behavior on one task.

metric.zh: 递归本身的收益：尚未分离
metric.en: gain from recursion itself: not isolated

title.zh: Fit, not format：编辑接口比格式重要
title.en: Fit, not format: the edit interface

what.zh: 这篇预印本要回答，编程智能体改代码时真正要紧的是编辑工具的格式，还是 harness 能不能在写入前核对选区。
what.en: This preprint asks whether a coding agent's edit format is what matters, or whether the harness can verify the selected lines before it writes.

how.zh: 在同一个开源 harness 里只改编辑工具，6 个模型、3 个基准、4,700 多次运行，校验选区让模型用行号定位并只引用首尾两行，核对后才应用，裸行号大约每 5 个大编辑就有 1 个悄悄写坏文件。
how.en: Inside one open-source harness only the edit tool changes, across six models, three benchmarks, and more than 4,700 runs, verified selection lets the model point with line numbers and quote only the first and last line, and bare line ranges silently break about one in five large edits.

why.zh: 大文件上 GPT-5.6-luna 用行号时首次编辑接受率 99%、搜索替换只有 58%，但两者都解出 94.4% 的任务，所以只优化成功率的搜索环会看不见写坏文件的成本和无声错误。
why.en: On large refactors GPT-5.6-luna's first edit is accepted 99% of the time with line numbers versus 58% with search and replace, yet both solve 94.4% of tasks, so a search loop that optimizes only success never sees the cost or the silent file damage.

metric.zh: 首次编辑 99% 对 58%，解题率相同

title.zh: OPAL：训练途中改写优化器
title.en: OPAL: an agent rewrites the optimizer mid-run

what.zh: OPAL 要回答，训练已经开始之后，一个没有元训练的语言模型能不能看着动态把优化器改好。
what.en: OPAL asks whether, after training has already started, a language model with no meta-training can watch the dynamics and improve the optimizer.

how.zh: 智能体每隔一段时间改写自己挑选的诊断和更新规则，例如学习率、Muon 和梯度裁剪，整个过程没有元训练，中性提示没有提升，多数实验只有一个种子，在已经调得很满的配方上收益变小。
how.en: Every so often the agent rewrites diagnostics it chooses and the update rule itself, such as the learning rate, Muon, and gradient clipping, with no meta-training, and a neutral prompt gave no gain, most runs use one seed, and gains shrink on heavily tuned recipes.

why.zh: 博客报告 LightningDiT-XL/1 的 FID-50K 从官方配方的 2.18 降到 1.83，说明运行中改优化器可以压过开训前定死的配方，但单种子的结果还不算稳。
why.en: The blog reports that LightningDiT-XL/1's FID-50K falls from 2.18 on the official recipe to 1.83, so rewriting the optimizer mid-run can beat a recipe fixed before training, though single-seed results are not yet stable.

title.zh: ScaleMAS：用搜索索引做多智能体的 harness
title.en: ScaleMAS: a search index as the multi-agent harness

what.zh: ScaleMAS 要解决的是往团队里加智能体常常没用，因为每个人要读的东西变多，好成果被淹没，一个出错就拖垮整组。
what.en: ScaleMAS tackles teams where adding agents fails because everyone has more to read, good work gets buried, and one failing agent can break the group.

how.zh: 智能体只共享一个链接消息库，每次搜索最多返回 8 条，按相关度加上被引用次数排序，计分是只要有一个智能体答对就算解出，而且只在推理阶段使用。
how.en: Agents share only a store of linked messages, each search returns at most 8 results, ranking mixes relevance with citations, a task counts as solved if any agent gets it right, and the system is inference-only.

why.zh: 用搜索索引代替互相通读之后，Qwen3.5-9B 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上从 1 个智能体的 38.1% 升到 16 个的 65.3%，因为质量信号把好结果顶了上来。
why.en: Replacing a shared reading pile with a search index lifts Qwen3.5-9B on BrowseComp-Plus from 38.1% with one agent to 65.3% with 16, because a citation signal keeps the good results on top.

title.zh: Agno：自改进要落在基础设施上
title.en: Agno: self-improvement belongs in the infrastructure

what.zh: Agno 的文章要论证，自改进如果只写在某一个 harness 里面，换一个运行时就会丢掉。
what.en: Agno's essay argues that self-improvement written only inside one harness is lost as soon as the runtime changes.

how.zh: 平台把源代码、对话、轨迹和评测交给编程智能体，沙箱里可以按不同角色和缺信息的问法重放，并比较改动前后，包括该追问时有没有追问，修一处集成后后来的智能体都能继承，文章没有对照分数。
how.en: The platform gives a coding agent the source, conversations, traces, and evaluations, a sandbox can replay requests from different roles and underspecified questions and compare before and after, including whether the agent asks when it should, and a fix to one integration is inherited by later agents, with no controlled score in the essay.

why.zh: 自改进要落在共享的运行、状态和评测记录上，后来的智能体才能继承，而不是只留在某一次提示里。
why.en: Self-improvement has to live in shared execution, state, and evaluation records so later agents can inherit it, rather than remaining inside a single prompt.

metric.zh: 改进写进平台，不写进某一个 harness
metric.en: the improvement lives in the platform

title.zh: Agent S4：智能体设计自己的计算机使用工具
title.en: Agent S4: agents design their own computer-use tools

what.zh: Agent S4 要解决的是计算机使用智能体被点击、截图和一个 shell 这些人事先设计的界面卡住。
what.en: Agent S4 tackles computer-use agents that are stuck behind human-designed interfaces of clicks, screenshots, and a shell.

how.zh: 元智能体研究任务智能体的运行记录，不断重写工具库和使用说明，只有在没见过的任务上更好的版本才留下来，演化本身大约再贡献 2 个点，每个任务的成本大约是 Opus 4.8 的七十分之一。
how.en: A meta-agent studies the task agent's runs and keeps rewriting a tool library and its notes, only versions that do better on unseen tasks survive, the evolution itself adds about 2 points, and the cost per task is about one seventieth of Opus 4.8.

why.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 在 OSWorld V2 上从 5.6% 到 21.3%，大部分跳跃来自换成一个能跑代码的 harness，而不是来自后面那一点演化。
why.en: Qwen3.8-27B moves from 5.6% to 21.3% on OSWorld V2, and most of that jump comes from switching to a harness that can run code rather than from the small evolution that follows.

title.zh: CoEvo-RSI：让模型跟上正在演化的 harness
title.en: CoEvo-RSI: keep the model in step with the harness

what.zh: CoEvo-RSI 要解决的是 harness 一演化，就会要求模型没学过的行为，或忽略模型已经有的技能。
what.en: CoEvo-RSI tackles the mismatch that appears once a harness evolves and starts asking for behavior the model never learned, or ignoring skills the model already has.

how.zh: 它保留每一版过去的 harness 和模型，为每个新 harness 挑选或合并最合适的模型版本，再用该版本自己的成功运行做微调，胜利在窄任务上，有些基准上它仍然落后。
how.en: It archives every past harness and model, picks or merges the model version that best fits each new harness, and fine-tunes it on that version's own successful runs, with wins on narrow tasks and trails on some benchmarks.

why.zh: 让模型版本跟上正在演化的 harness 之后，一个 9B 模型在“哪一步导致失败”上达到 70.8%，超过 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的 56.6%，API 费用大约 2.72 美元。
why.en: Keeping the model version in step with the evolving harness lets a 9B model reach 70.8% on naming the step that caused a failure, above DeepSeek-V4-Pro's 56.6%, for about $2.72 of API calls.

title.zh: FrontierMemory：测的是变好，不是想起
title.en: FrontierMemory: measure improvement, not recall

what.zh: FrontierMemory 要测量的不是智能体能不能想起过去，而是过去的尝试能不能让另一个模型真正解出更多题。
what.en: FrontierMemory measures not whether an agent can recall the past, but whether past attempts raise another model's solve rate.

how.zh: 智能体阅读先前成功和失败的记录并写下记忆笔记，分数是这些笔记把另一个模型的解决率提高了多少，而这个基准是 Letta 自己做的。
how.en: An agent reads transcripts of earlier successes and failures, writes memory notes, and the score is how much those notes raise another model's solve rate, on a benchmark Letta itself built.

why.zh: 按笔记是否让别的模型变好来打分时，Letta 自己的 harness 以 73.3% 排在榜首，Hermes Agent 是 26.7%，这个差距要连同建造者一起看。
why.en: When the score is whether the notes make another model better, Letta's own harness leads at 73.3% and Hermes Agent sits at 26.7%, and that gap has to be read together with the fact that Letta made the benchmark.

title.zh: AgenticEvolve：提交前先在本地把实验跑了
title.en: AgenticEvolve: run the experiment before you commit

what.zh: AgenticEvolve 要解决的是没有终端的进化智能体只能在正式提交之后才知道代码有没有用，于是把评测预算烧在猜测上。
what.en: AgenticEvolve tackles evolution agents that have no terminal and learn whether code helps only after an official commit, so they burn the evaluation budget on guesses.

how.zh: 它仍然藏起官方测试集，只多给分析脚本和每次提交最多 10 次的本地运行，让智能体先写模拟器、造合成测试并调参，再花掉 30 次正式提交之一。没有这个工具时，模型每次请求要烧掉 1.5 万到 2.7 万个推理 token。
how.en: It still hides the official test set and only adds an analysis script plus up to 10 local runs per commit, so the agent writes a simulator, builds synthetic tests, and tunes parameters before spending one of 30 official commits. Without that tool a model burns 15,000 to 27,000 reasoning tokens per request.

why.zh: 提交前先在本地把实验跑了，所以它在每个模型和每个未见测试集上都超过没有分析工具的基线，正式评测次数只是一个零头。
why.en: Running the experiment locally before the commit is why it beats the no-analysis baseline on every model and every unseen test set, while using only a fraction of the official evaluations.

metric.zh: 少一次正式评测，少 1.5–2.7 万推理 token
metric.en: fewer official evals, 15–27k fewer reasoning tokens

pills.zh: 每次 commit 的本地运行

title.zh: ScholarEvolve：从论文里给 harness 找改法
title.en: ScholarEvolve: harness edits drawn from papers

what.zh: ScholarEvolve 要解决的是自进化 harness 的元智能体通常只能提出它本来就知道的改法。
what.en: ScholarEvolve tackles self-evolving harnesses whose meta-agent can usually propose only changes it already knows.

how.zh: 它先分析失败任务，再去 arXiv 找能补短板的技术，把论文转成工具、上下文、技能、记忆或工作流之一的代码改动，只保留通过回归测试的改动，权重不改，从论文引进的代码没有经过审查。
how.en: It analyzes failed tasks, looks on arXiv for techniques that cover the gaps, turns each paper into a code change to tools, context, skills, memory, or workflow, keeps only changes that pass regression tests, leaves the weights fixed, and does not audit the imported code.

why.zh: 从论文里给 harness 找改法，把 Qwen3.5-27B 在 AppWorld 上从 69.0% 提到 81.4%，没见过的应用也从 49.6% 提到 63.6%。
why.en: Drawing harness edits from papers lifts Qwen3.5-27B from 69.0% to 81.4% on AppWorld and from 49.6% to 63.6% on unseen apps.

title.zh: Harness-Delta：进化出来的提升有多少是真的
title.en: Harness-Delta: how much of the gain is real

what.zh: Harness-Delta 要拆开进化 harness 之后的提升里，有多少是真进步，有多少是对搜索集过拟合或多用了算力。
what.en: Harness-Delta separates how much of an evolved harness's gain is real progress, how much is overfitting to the search set, and how much is extra compute.

how.zh: 每个进化后的 harness 有两个对照，一是原始 harness 拿到同样的算力预算，二是关掉进化后 harness 里的基准捷径，两者都扣除后剩下的才算真实改进的上限。有些 ALFWorld harness 变成了完全不调用模型的硬编码控制器。
how.en: Each evolved harness is compared with the original harness given the same compute budget and with its benchmark shortcuts turned off, and what remains after both deductions is an upper bound on the real improvement. Some ALFWorld harnesses became hardcoded controllers that never call the model.

why.zh: 21 个设置里过拟合平均解释了 54% 的提升、额外算力解释了 14%，所以进化出来的分数在扣掉这两项之前还不能当成方法变强。
why.en: Across 21 settings overfitting explains 54% of the gain on average and extra compute explains 14%, so an evolved score is not yet a stronger method until those two are subtracted.

metric.zh: 过拟合解释 54% 的提升

title.zh: HarnessAdapt-RL：训练编码智能体时一起改 harness
title.en: HarnessAdapt-RL: train the coder and the harness together

what.zh: HarnessAdapt-RL 要回答，训练编码智能体的权重时把 harness 固定住，是不是在浪费同步改进的机会。
what.en: HarnessAdapt-RL asks whether freezing the harness while a coding agent's weights train wastes a chance to improve both together.

how.zh: 每两次训练更新之间，一个教师写不带文件名和代码的修复解释，另一个教师提出新工具，只有通过率和可用于训练的运行比例都不下降才保留，去掉进化出的工具最多会掉 7.7 个点，每种配置只训练了一次。
how.en: Between every two training updates one teacher writes a fix explanation without file names or code and another proposes new tools, a change is kept only when both the pass rate and the share of trainable runs do not fall, removing the evolved tools drops as much as 7.7 points, and each configuration was trained once.

why.zh: 训练编码智能体时一起改 harness，让 9B 的 Qwen3.5 在三类 SWE-bench 上平均达到 44.9%，普通强化学习只有 35.3%，所以模型和脚手架必须一起部署。
why.en: Evolving the harness during training lifts a 9B Qwen3.5 to an average of 44.9% across three SWE-bench suites against 35.3% for ordinary reinforcement learning, so the model and the scaffold have to ship together.

title.zh: Altman：递归自我改进需要速度限制
title.en: Altman: recursive self-improvement needs speed limits

what.zh: 这张卡记录的是 Sam Altman 在访谈里把递归自我改进说成一件需要速度限制的危险推动。
what.en: This card records Sam Altman, in an interview, calling recursive self-improvement a dangerous push that needs speed limits.

how.zh: 他描述两条走错的路，意外失去控制，或者一个实验室为了保住权力而故意加速，材料是 @Hesamation 的片段，完整访谈没有看。
how.en: He describes two ways it goes wrong, an accidental loss of control or a lab deliberately speeding up to secure power, and the source is @Hesamation's clip rather than the full interview.

why.zh: 这是一段访谈引语而不是实验，而且如果打破速度限制的人赢得竞赛，谁会真正遵守限制并不清楚。
why.en: This is an interview line rather than an experiment, and if breaking the speed limit wins the race it is unclear who would actually keep it.

metric.zh: 两条失败路径：事故，或故意加速
metric.en: two failure paths: accident, or a deliberate push

title.zh: “harness 工程已死”是一条弱论点
title.en: “Harness engineering is dead” is a weak claim

what.zh: 这张卡要辨认的是，用一篇弱论文宣布 harness 工程已经结束，这个论点本身站不站得住。
what.en: This card asks whether declaring harness engineering over on the back of one weak paper is an argument that holds.

how.zh: 争论两边都把个别论文的负结果当成整个方向的判决，而同一天对记忆方法的重跑说明的是增益很脆，不是脚手架不再影响结果，@omarsar0 的帖子有 35 条回复。
how.en: Both sides treated a negative result in one paper as a verdict on the whole direction, while a same-day rerun of memory methods shows that gains are fragile rather than that scaffolding stopped mattering, and @omarsar0's post drew 35 replies.

why.zh: “harness 工程已死”是一种过度概括，因为一篇弱论文的负结果说明不了脚手架不再改变结果。
why.en: Calling harness engineering dead is an overgeneralization, because a negative result in one weak paper does not show that scaffolding stopped changing outcomes.

title.zh: Salesforce：自改进的增益很脆
title.en: Salesforce: self-improvement gains are fragile

what.zh: Salesforce 的重跑要看，两种知名的、基于记忆的自改进，在随机性、任务顺序和松散设置一变时增益还在不在。
what.en: Salesforce's rerun asks whether two well-known memory-based self-improvements still hold once randomness, task order, and a loose setup change.

how.zh: 基准是 WebArena 风格的任务，他们变动的是种子、任务顺序和写得比较松的实验设置，帖子没有给出可引用的百分比。
how.en: The benchmarks are WebArena-style tasks, and what they varied was the seed, the order of tasks, and loosely specified setups, with no citable percentage in the post.

why.zh: 增益随着种子和任务顺序移动，所以一份只在一种顺序、一个种子上成立的记忆提升，还不是这个方法本身的性质。
why.en: The gains moved with the seed and the task order, so a memory improvement that exists for one order and one seed is not yet a property of the method.

metric.zh: 增益随种子和任务顺序移动
metric.en: gains moved with seed and task order

value.zh: 随机性 · 顺序 · 设置

title.zh: Beacon：把编码会话收成可复用技能
title.en: Beacon: coding sessions become reusable skills

what.zh: Beacon 要做的是把真实编码会话收成可复用技能，并让同一层记忆跨多个编程 harness 使用。
what.en: Beacon turns real coding sessions into reusable skills and aims to use that same memory layer across many coding harnesses.

how.zh: 技能从 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和另外二十多个 harness 的真实会话里长出来，而不是事先写成一份静态文档，帖子约有 10.9 万次浏览，@jqdsouza 宣布 Asymptote Labs 融资 550 万美元并发布这层记忆。
how.en: Skills grow out of real sessions in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 20-plus other harnesses rather than being written ahead as a static document, the post had about 109,000 views, and @jqdsouza announced that Asymptote Labs raised $5.5 million and launched the memory layer.

why.zh: 这是一次产品发布而不是留出集实验，550 万美元和约 10.9 万次浏览说明的是关注度，不是技能层把解决率提高了多少。
why.en: This is a product launch rather than a held-out experiment, and the $5.5 million plus about 109,000 views measure attention, not how much the skill layer raises the solve rate.

metric.zh: 融资 $5.5M · 约 109k 次浏览

title.zh: PretrainGym：考模型会不会挑选预训练数据
title.en: PretrainGym: can a model curate pretraining data

what.zh: PretrainGym 要考的是前沿模型会不会挑选预训练数据，而不是会不会在下游把题答对。
what.en: PretrainGym tests whether frontier models can curate pretraining data, not whether they can answer downstream questions.

how.zh: 如果递归自我改进包含模型参与制造下一代的训练分布，数据挑选就是那条环的入口，帖子没有给出可引用的分数，@HuNtEr_J1324 介绍了 Prime Intellect 的这个基准。
how.en: If recursive self-improvement includes a model helping build the next generation's training distribution, data curation is the entrance to that loop, the post gives no citable score, and @HuNtEr_J1324 covers Prime Intellect's benchmark.

why.zh: 这张卡的结论是基准已经被提出，它在递归自我改进的地图上标的是训练分布的入口，而不是又一个下游记忆技巧。
why.en: The conclusion is that the benchmark has been proposed, and on a map of recursive self-improvement it marks the entrance to the training distribution rather than another downstream memory trick.

metric.zh: 测的是数据挑选，不是下游答题
metric.en: it tests data curation, not downstream answers

title.zh: 自我改进的上限是核对有多便宜
title.en: Self-improvement stops where checking gets expensive

what.zh: 这篇文章要论证，自我改进只能走到核对一个答案比产生一个答案更便宜的地方。
what.en: This essay argues that self-improvement only goes as far as the point where checking an answer stays cheaper than producing one.

how.zh: 论证把瓶颈从生成能力移到验证成本，并举了大量评分器被智能体骗过的例子，文章阅读量当时不大，作者是 @_krish00。
how.en: The argument moves the bottleneck from the ability to generate to the cost of verification, with many examples of graders that agents learn to fool, and the essay, written by @_krish00, had few readers at the time.

why.zh: 生成可以变快，但核对若仍然又贵又容易被钻空子，报告出来的进步就还不可信，环也会停在那里。
why.en: Generation can get faster, but if checking stays expensive and easy to game, a reported improvement is not yet believable and the loop stops there.

metric.zh: 核对比产生更便宜，环才能往前
metric.en: the loop moves only while checking stays cheaper

title.zh: Socher：RSI 可能在一年内到来，但不是一夜之间
title.en: Socher: RSI may arrive within a year, not overnight

what.zh: 这张卡记录 Richard Socher 的判断：递归自我改进可能在一年内到来，但不是突然的一夜跳跃。
what.en: This card records Richard Socher's judgment that recursive self-improvement may arrive within a year, though not as a sudden overnight leap.

how.zh: 他把 RSI 说成一段可观察的工程过程，系统逐步接手更多改进自身的工作，而不是一个开关，材料是 @superdatasci 的访谈，没有伴随实验。
how.en: He frames it as an observable engineering process in which a system gradually takes on more of the work of improving itself, rather than as a switch, and the source is @superdatasci's interview, with no experiment attached.

why.zh: 一年这个数字是一段访谈里的预期，不是测量出来的到达时间。
why.en: The one-year figure is an expectation stated in an interview, not a measured arrival time.

metric.zh: 预期：一年内，渐进而非一夜
metric.en: expectation: within a year, gradual rather than overnight

title.zh: DeepMind：学得最快的智能体，忘掉的旧任务也最多
title.en: DeepMind: the fastest learner broke the most old tasks

what.zh: DeepMind 的这篇论文要看，靠编辑自己的提示、记忆或技能来变好的智能体，学新任务时会不会弄坏旧任务。
what.en: This DeepMind paper asks whether agents that improve by editing their own prompts, memory, or skill files break old tasks while learning new ones.

how.zh: 改进发生在模型外面的文件上，所以遗忘不是权重里的灾难性遗忘，而是外部记忆被新经验覆盖，这张卡依据的是当天的帖子而不是论文全文，因此不引用表格百分比，@rohanpaul_ai 介绍了论文，@omarsar0 也推荐了它。
how.en: The improvement happens in files outside the model, so the forgetting is external memory being overwritten by new experience rather than catastrophic forgetting in the weights, and this card follows that day's posts rather than the full paper, so it cites no table percentages, as covered by @rohanpaul_ai and @omarsar0.

why.zh: 学得最快的智能体弄坏的旧任务也最多，难点因此落在记忆和检索，而不是再把新技能写进文件。
why.en: The agent that learned fastest also broke the most old tasks, so the hard part is memory and retrieval rather than writing yet another skill into a file.

metric.zh: 学得越快，旧任务掉得越多
metric.en: the faster the learning, the more old tasks broke

what.en: This card marks one entry point, a podcast chapter in which Sundar Pichai discusses how close the start of recursive self-improvement is.

title.zh: Nathan Calvin 回应 Dario：全速 RSI 与监管
title.en: Nathan Calvin replies to Dario on RSI and regulation

what.zh: Nathan Calvin 的长文要争的是，一边全速做递归自我改进、一边反对可能约束它的监管，这算不算说得过去。
what.en: Nathan Calvin's essay argues over whether it is defensible to race on recursive self-improvement while opposing regulation that might constrain it.

how.zh: 他认为冲向 RSI 只有作为最后手段、并且实验室在全力推动强治理时才说得过去，并举 AEGIS Act 以及 Anthropic 早先削弱 SB 1047 和 RAISE 法案为例，这张卡读的是 Calvin 的全文而不是 Dario 的原帖，当天约 380 个赞。
how.en: He argues that racing is defensible only as a last resort and only if the lab is also pushing hard for strong governance, pointing to the AEGIS Act and to Anthropic's earlier weakening of SB 1047 and the RAISE Act, and this card follows Calvin's essay rather than Dario's original post, which had about 380 likes that day.

why.zh: 这是一条治理论点而不是技术结果：全速研发递归自我改进，若同时反对可能约束它的规则，就不能再被说成只是防御性的最后手段。
why.en: This is a governance argument rather than a technical result: racing to build recursive self-improvement while opposing rules that might constrain it can no longer be described as only a defensive last resort.

metric.zh: 约 380 赞，当天互动最多的 RSI 帖之一
metric.en: about 380 likes, among the day's most discussed RSI posts

title.zh: 中国公司如何谈论 RSI
title.en: How Chinese companies talk about RSI

what.zh: GovAI 的这篇文章要回答，中国实验室改口谈论 RSI，到底是一场国家协调的竞赛，还是一股商业潮流。
what.en: This GovAI essay asks whether Chinese labs switching to the language of RSI is a state-coordinated race or a commercial current.

how.zh: 他们用公司文件、投资和政策文本发现，实验室直到 2026 年 7 月才从“自进化”改用 RSI，大约在 Anthropic 的文章一个月之后，推动者是红杉中国和智谱，9 月的安全治理框架里 RSI 只占一句，MiniMax M2.7 公开自己的 harness 改了 100 多轮、内部评测提升 30%。
how.en: Using company documents, investment, and policy text, they find that labs did not switch from self-evolution to RSI until July 2026, about a month after Anthropic's essay, with the push coming from HongShan and Z.ai, September's safety framework giving RSI one sentence, and MiniMax M2.7 reporting more than 100 harness rounds plus a 30% gain on an internal eval.

why.zh: 结论是这是一股自下而上的商业潮流，不是一场已经写进国家计划的竞赛，而且中国实验室在用 AI 研发 AI 上公开的细节往往更多。
why.en: The conclusion is a bottom-up commercial current rather than a race already written into a national plan, and Chinese labs often publish more detail on using AI to develop AI.
